tagline: Write CSS grid, grow carrots — offline, and one invite shares the garden.
description:
Close it on a plane and you are still on the same bed: the file is the save. Press Invite in the bar above, send the link, and a friend lands on the same plot with the same CSS. You water and poison together, no account, no site to keep open.

On your own it is Grid Garden. Twenty-eight levels. Type grid-column, grid-row, grid-area, order, and grid-template until the water covers the carrots and the poison covers the weeds. Next lights up when the beds match. The harvest scene is still Froggy's 20-carrot cake.

An unofficial port of Grid Garden by Thomas Park. The levels and the garden art are his.
